Class NostrRelayWatchdog

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.NostrRelayWatchdog
All Implemented Interfaces:
NostrRelayComponent
public class NostrRelayWatchdog extends Object implements NostrRelayComponent
Last resort watchdog that attempts to reconnect to the relay if it becomes unresponsive or broken even if the connection is still alive. (eg. some invalid state or breakage on the relay side)
